name: Akuma no Tesaki ~20 Nin Renzoku Goukan~
original_name: 悪魔の手先～２０人連続強姦～
source:
Through a chance occurrence, a vagrant, Kariya Hiroshi, who is just as evil as the devil himself, ends up sealing a contract with a demon.

And the price for making one wish come true is...his life?!!

When Kariya tries to repeal the contract, the black demon possesses the body of a traveler and tells him to go and violate girls.

And Kariya, feeling sorry for himself, takes the demon up on his proposal.

Will Kariya be able to extend his life by doing as the demon bids and capturing, then violating virgins?!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039925.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一次偶然事件中，和恶魔一样邪恶的流浪汉刈谷博史与恶魔签订了契约。

实现一个愿望的代价竟然是……他的生命？！！

刈谷试图废除契约时，黑色恶魔附身于一名旅人的身体，命令他去侵犯女孩。

刈谷自怨自艾，接受了恶魔的提议。

刈谷能否按照恶魔的命令抓捕并侵犯处女，以此延长自己的寿命？！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039925.html]DLsite English[/url]]
